objects.description: [Embargo](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1247) has utilized MS4Killer to detect running processes on the victim device.(Citation: ESET Embargo Ransomware October 2024) [Embargo](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1247) has also captured a snapshot of active running processes using the Windows API `CreateToolHelp32Snapshot()`.(Citation: Cyble Embargo Ransomware May 2024)
